verdict.rationale: Plausible documents an Events API that can record pageviews/custom events and is explicitly recommended for mobile (Android/iOS) and server-side tracking, and a JS snippet for web — but this is a single generic HTTP API, not a set of official SDKs per language/platform. No evidence of dedicated iOS/Android/Node/Python/etc. SDK libraries. missing for 10: official language-specific SDKs (mobile, backend) beyond the raw HTTP Events API, code samples/wrappers, independent confirmation of SDK usage.
